Its doc comment says "landing, history and attribution rules are derived from the happy-path commit shape", names all three job ids and the three introspections, and says "Declared here: expected 4% of newly refused readings. The doc of check_reading_acceptance lists [`check_history_fixture`]. history_fixture_has_one_step_line passed (the step appears exactly once, right after code_survey). The refusal test fails if the check is removed from refusing_check.
criteria.evidence: history_fixture_refuses_a_rule_tested_only_on_job_commits passed, along with the 1rve, e65v and hac3 shape tests. Near misses (a content-kind fixture criterion, a missing shape, a missing 'realistic' or 'fixture') stay refused. findings.summary: The retry-after-block landing, the shape the failure class says was missed, is not enforced by the check
findings.evidence: The check requires only an intervention commit, a records-only commit and the job landing, which is the set the accepted reading named. The doc comment and CHANGELOG say plainly that the retry-after-block shape is left to the planner's commit-shape table, and the refusal text asks the reader to name it. This matches the reading but leaves part of the cited cause covered by prose only.

findings.summary: Trigger reads criterion text only; the reading's assumption also listed deliverable paths as a trigger
findings.evidence: The reading's goal assumption says the check fires when deliverables include land.rs, history.rs, attribution.rs or gh.rs check functions, or when a criterion mentions such a rule. The implementation deliberately drops the path trigger to avoid false positives on landing-queue jobs, and the critic-accepted plan chose this. A landing-rule reading whose criteria avoid every listed phrase (for example 'the landing classifier accepts X') would pass unchecked.

findings.summary: Lexical check: a reading can satisfy it without the fixture really existing, and 'trailer' fires even when negated
findings.evidence: A criterion is accepted if it holds the words 'realistic', 'fixture' and the three shape phrases. The doc comment admits there is no handling of negation. This is inherent to a reading-stage check that reads only the Reading. The verifier stage still has to confirm the fixture exists. Athena's replay found 0 of 50 accepted readings newly refused, so false positives look low.

summary: The change does what the request and the accepted reading ask. It adds `check_history_fixture` to reading.rs as a `step!` in `refusing_check`, directly after `check_code_survey`. The check refuses a code or tests reading that has a behavior criterion and states a rule on commit classification, the history check, the attribution check or trailers, unless some behavior criterion names a realistic-branch fixture with an intervention commit, a records-only commit and the job landing. Until now this guard existed only as prose in the planner and critic prompts. The new doc comment and the CHANGELOG entry both name the root cause (rules derived from the happy-path commit shape) and the three jobs. They explain why the fix sits where readings are accepted rather than in one `pr_commits` or trailer instance, and declare an expected 4% of readings newly refused, labelled as an estimate. I ran `cargo test -p athena-core reading` (181 passed, all 8 new history_fixture tests among them), the refusal corpus (14 passed, including the new refuse and accept cases) and the athena-context landing_rules test (passed). fmt, clippy and the full test suite passed in Athena's recorded CI run. Athena's replay found 0 of 50 accepted readings newly refused. Four minor issues: refusal_corpus.rs changed although it is not on the expected deliverables list (it was planned, and an existing test requires a corpus case for every check). The retry-after-block shape named in the failure class is not enforced, which matches the reading and is documented as a limit. The trigger reads criterion text only, not deliverable paths as the reading's assumption described. The check matches words, so a reading can satisfy it without the fixture really existing.
